g.text: Title: INA228 smart current profiler (nA - 2.5A), rev C

g.desc: Title: INA228 smart current profiler (nA - 2.5A), rev C

g.text: On-board STM32G030 auto-ranging + comparator fast up-range; one value out over I2C / UART

g.desc: On-board STM32G030 auto-ranging + comparator fast up-range; one value out over I2C / UART

g.text: Smart variant: the on-board STM32G030 switches the ranges and the host reads one number (I2C slave 0x48 or CSV over UART).

g.desc: Smart variant: the on-board STM32G030 switches the ranges and the host reads one number (I2C slave 0x48 or CSV over UART).

g.text: Ranges as in rev A: L = R1+R2+R3, M = R1+R2+Rds(Q2), H = R1+Rds(Q1). CTL_x HIGH = bypass FET ON (default at reset).

g.desc: Ranges as in rev A: L = R1+R2+R3, M = R1+R2+Rds(Q2), H = R1+Rds(Q1). CTL_x HIGH = bypass FET ON (default at reset).

g.text: U3 trips in ~1 us when VIN - DUT_VDD > Vth (~32 mV = 1k x ~32 uA from Q5) and the MCU steps up one range at once.

g.desc: U3 trips in ~1 us when VIN - DUT_VDD > Vth (~32 mV = 1k x ~32 uA from Q5) and the MCU steps up one range at once.

g.text: U3 IN+ sits on DUT_VDD: keep it a short, clean trace (5 pA input). R11/Q5/U3 are fed from VIN, upstream of the shunts.

g.desc: U3 IN+ sits on DUT_VDD: keep it a short, clean trace (5 pA input). R11/Q5/U3 are fed from VIN, upstream of the shunts.

g.text: VIN 1.8 V to 5.5 V (U3 supply and FET Vgs). 3V3 for INA228 + MCU comes from the host header J3. Program U2 over SWD (J4).

g.desc: VIN 1.8 V to 5.5 V (U3 supply and FET Vgs). 3V3 for INA228 + MCU comes from the host header J3. Program U2 over SWD (J4).
